en.html: That was... The monster from that time!! There was not one chance in ten thousand of mistaking it for something merely similar. That unidentified armor which had blocked my way to Kenchouji—'distinctive' was far too small a word for that deformity. A thousand years could pass; I would not forget it. Why here? For what? en.text:
That was...
The monster from that time!!

There was not one chance in ten thousand of mistaking it for something merely similar. That unidentified armor which had blocked my way to Kenchouji—'distinctive' was far too small a word for that deformity.

A thousand years could pass; I would not forget it.

Why here?
For what?

Had it been part of the occupation forces after all!?
And now, working with Ichizo Sorimachi—◆to do what!?

ja.html: あれは…… 　あの時の怪物騎!! 　万に一つも、別物の空似ということは有り得ない。 　あの日、建朝寺に向かう途上で、俺を阻んだ不明騎アンノウン ――特徴的などという一言では表しきれないその異形。 　千年経とうと、忘れる筈がなかった。 　何故、ここに。 　何の、ために。 　あれはやはり、進駐軍の戦力であったのか!? 　それが今、雪車町一蔵と結託して――◆何を!?

The bridge...

The bridge had been destroyed!

So that was it!!
This train was just about to run onto the bridge.
And the bridge was gone. Nothing there but empty air.

Under the empty air, a river.

—That was where this train would sink.

With myself and the Ootori pair still aboard.

　橋が破壊された！

　虚空の下には河。

en.text:
The decision took an instant.
Jump off—◆only I survive. Rejected.◆Warn Captain Ootori first—◆no time for that. Rejected.

Stop it.◆
There was only stopping it. Get round in front...

This train—I had to hold it back by brute force!

en.html:
The carriages were moving on inertia alone. Even so, the speed was still quite sufficient.
And then there was their weight: enormous boxes of iron.

A tremendous momentum came down upon me.

Impossible————impossible!

I could not support such a thing.
Keep from being run over—that was barely within my strength.

My four limbs had become a prop. Let that arrangement give way even a little, and in that instant my body would disappear beneath the wheels.
Not even Muramasa's steel could keep my life attached to me then.

Meeting this feeble resistance, the steel wheels ground against the iron tracks and shrieked.
To my ears, nothing but a carnivore grinding its teeth over the meal before it.

Fear of death—I had tasted it how many times, and still it would not become familiar. I almost lost the strength in my hands and feet.
I roused every scrap of spirit and endured. I must not lose. Lose, and it was the end.

Of me. Of the two inside as well.

Face it. Brace the arms, brace the legs. Push back that enormous mass with muscle alone.

But both feet kept sliding, without end.
My soles were giving off the heat of an iron plate for grilling meat.

I could not hold my ground.
The train would not stop. I could not stop it.

Where was the bridge—where the bridge had been?
How much room did I have?

Before the train fell, how much,

ja.html:
惰性で走り続けているに過ぎない車両は、しかし、
まだ充分に高速だ。
　加えるに、鉄製の巨箱であるその重さ。

　途方もない<ruby>運動量<rt>モーメンタム</rt></ruby>が俺に襲い掛かる。

　無理だ――――無理だ！

　とてもこんなものは支えられない。
　<ruby>轢<rt>ひ</rt></ruby>き潰されぬようこらえるのが<ruby>漸々<rt>やっと</rt></ruby>。

　<ruby>つっかえぼう<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>の形になっている四肢がわずかにでも
体勢を崩せば、その刹那、俺の肉体は車輪の下に消え
失せるだろう。
　村正の甲鉄も、一命を繋ぎ止める役には立つまい。

　微弱な抵抗を受けて<ruby>条鉄<rt>レール</rt></ruby>との間に摩擦を生じ、鋼の
車輪が耳障りな音をかき鳴らす。
　俺にはそれが、餌を目の前にした肉食獣の歯軋りと
しか聞こえなかった。

　幾度味わっても慣れることがない死の恐怖に、とも
すれば手足の力を失ってしまいそうになる。
　総身の意気を奮い起こして耐えた――負けてはなら
ない。負けたら終わりだ。

　俺も、中の二人も。

　立ち向かう。腕を張り脚を張り。あまりにも膨大な
質量を筋力のみで押し返す。

　だが両足は際限なく滑る。
　足裏は焼肉の鉄板さながらの高熱を発していた。

　踏み留まれない。
　列車は停まらない。停められない。

　橋は――橋があった場所は何処だ。
　あとどれだけの余裕がある。

　列車が落ちるまで、あとどれだけ、
